description: The same check as the trip planner: for each cave of a region (or the given caves), whether the whole team can dive it, only partly, or not, with the reasons and the warnings that apply to them.

caves.description: Cave ids; default all caves of the region.

cert.description: Cave level: ow (none), cavern, intro, full.

configs.description: What they dive: backmount, sidemount, ccr, small (small/no-mount).

dpv.description: Brings a scooter and is DPV-trained.

gasCerts.description: Gas certifications: nitrox, adv_nitrox, deco, normoxic, hypoxic.

maxDepth.description: Their own depth limit in metres, if lower than their certifications give.

lang.description: Language of the texts: nl, en (default), fr, es or de.

name: check_team
title: Which caves fit a team
